hero.description: Passionate about web and mobile development, I build modern applications with React, Next.js and Flutter. While pursuing a master's degree in web development, I work as a fullstack developer apprentice and support businesses through my freelance activity.

paragraphs: Fullstack developer based in Rennes, I am pursuing a master's degree in web development while working as a fullstack developer apprentice. My education has allowed me to master web and mobile development, from frontend to backend.
Alongside my studies, I founded DVS Web, my freelance activity where I help businesses create their digital projects: showcase websites, web applications, e-commerce and SEO optimisation.
This dual role as apprentice and entrepreneur allows me to combine technical rigour with hands-on experience, delivering concrete and high-performing solutions.

In the workplace as in freelancing, my background as a developer gives me a deep understanding of technical challenges, which I sharpen daily through project leadership, coordination and delivery management.

SaaS platform that analyses construction tender documents. AI reads the tender package (specifications, price schedules) and returns a priced bill of quantities lot by lot with confidence scores, Excel export and reports. Stripe subscriptions and asynchronous processing.
features: Full tender package upload (specifications, price schedules, drawings) with automatic extraction
Priced bill of quantities lot by lot with per-line confidence scores
Sensitive points, grey areas and questions for the project owner
Excel export and PDF report generation
Stripe subscriptions and payments
Long-running asynchronous jobs with live progress

items.description: Prediction platform for amateur football in Brittany (regional leagues and cups). Ionic/Capacitor mobile app published on Google Play, admin back office, SEO showcase website and Supabase backend (Edge Functions).
features: Predictions on real weekend fixtures with leaderboards between friends
Ionic + Capacitor mobile app published on Google Play
React back office to manage matchdays and results
SEO-optimised Next.js showcase website (standings, clubs, fixtures)
Supabase backend: Edge Functions, migrations and seeds
Blog and editorial content about amateur football in Brittany

items.description: SaaS application for AI-powered CV generation. Integrates OpenAI (GPT-4o-mini) for content optimisation, Stripe for payments, and NextAuth with 2FA. 5 templates, ATS analysis and PDF export.
features: 5 CV templates (Modern, Classic, ATS-Friendly, Minimal, Creative)
ATS analysis: Score 0-100 with recommendations
AI suggestions for content improvement
OAuth authentication (Google, GitHub) + 2FA with QR code
Stripe payment (1 free template, premium at £4.99)
High-quality PDF export
Transactional emails (welcome, password reset, payment confirmation)
